Meta.title: Taksu Tech receptionist robot kiosk demo
Meta.description: Try the Timo and Snow receptionist robot touchscreens: queue tickets, directions, organisation chart, Aksara Bali, and an AI assistant.

Launcher.title: Receptionist robot kiosk demo
Launcher.intro: Pick a robot and a sample venue. This is the same screen shown on the robot’s 13.3-inch touchscreen.
Launcher.tip: Use the full-screen button at the top right for a lobby-like experience.
Launcher.sampleNote: All names, numbers, and schedules in this demo are sample data.
Launcher.studioBody: Build a kiosk with your name and Aksara Bali sign in Studio.

lines.home: Please choose a menu on the screen.
lines.organization: Here is our organisation chart. Touch a name to see their room.
lines.wayfinding: Where would you like to go? Pick a destination and I will show you the way.
lines.queue: Choose a service to take a queue number.
lines.aksara: Type your name and I will write it in Aksara Bali.
lines.culture: Here are a few Balinese customs worth knowing.
lines.voice: Press the microphone button, then speak.
lines.guestbook: Please fill in your visit details.

Organization.select: Touch a name to see their room.

Wayfinding.distance: About {meters} metres, {minutes, plural, =0 {under a minute} one {# minute} other {# minutes}} on foot

steps.left: Turn left, then go straight for {meters} metres
steps.right: Turn right, then go straight for {meters} metres

Wayfinding.empty: Choose a destination to see the route on the map.
Wayfinding.noEscort: This kiosk does not move. Print a route slip or scan the QR to open the map on your phone.

Queue.ahead: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is ahead of you} one {# person ahead of you} other {# people ahead of you}}
Queue.line: Your number is {code}. Please wait to be called at {counter}.

Assistant.error: Sorry, I cannot answer right now. Please try again, or ask a member of staff.
Assistant.offline: Offline mode: answers come from this venue’s data.
Assistant.rateLimited: That was a lot of questions at once. Please wait a moment, then ask again.

Aksara.label: Your name
Aksara.placeholder: Type a name, for example Wayan
Aksara.hint: A plain e reads like the e in Ketut. Type é for the sound in Madé.
Aksara.empty: Your Aksara Bali will appear here
Aksara.note: Automatic transliteration. For inscriptions or official signs, ask a Balinese language adviser to review it.
